name: Pine
description: Pine is a website template for small mountain guesthouses, with a hero that pairs the house photo with trail signposts showing walking times to nearby sights and a date and guests bar, an availability calendar with booked nights per room, seasonal rates and the price of the whole stay, room cards with prices per night, a breakfast section with hours, what is on the table and a diet question, a trails section with a summer and winter switch, a hosts section with key facts, guest reviews, house rules for check-in, parking and pets, and an availability form. Forest green, cream and the colours of mountain trail marks with Oswald headings give the website a calm, outdoor character. Replace the copy, prices, trails, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with trail signposts showing walking times and an arrival, departure and guests bar
Availability calendar: booked nights per room, seasonal rates, minimum stay and the total price, keyboard accessible
Room cards with guests, size and price per night
Breakfast section with hours, a menu list and a diet enquiry
Three room pages with amenities and a booking enquiry
Trails section with a summer and winter switch and route facts
Hosts section with key facts about the guesthouse
Guest reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
House rules: check-in, check-out, minimum stay, parking, pets and quiet hours
Area page with summer trails, waterfalls and winter slopes nearby
Availability enquiry form with dates and room choice
